params.name: value
params.doc: Null is missing data, never zero.

params.name: headline
params.doc: Host-provided amount. The kit never computes a headline total.

PaymentCheckbox.doc:
A checkbox with its label, for consent and opt-in choices.

The whole row is one 48 dp target and one screen-reader node ("Save this
card, checkbox, checked"). Controlled: the host owns `value` and gets
`onChanged`. A null `onChanged` disables the row; pass `disabledReason`
so people know why.

params.name: label
params.doc:
What checking the box agrees to, as a full phrase: "Save this card for
next time", not "Save".

params.name: description
params.doc: A muted line under the label.

params.name: disabledReason
params.doc: Replaces `description` while the row is disabled.

PaymentRadio.doc:
One option of a single choice. Give every option in the group the same
`groupValue` and `onChanged`; the option whose `value` equals
`groupValue` is selected.

Selection shows as a filled ring, not only a color: the selected mark is
a thick accent ring, the others a thin muted one. Use radios for two to
about five options that all fit on screen.

params.name: onChanged
params.doc: Called with `value` when this option is chosen. Null disables it.

params.name: disabledReason
params.doc: Replaces `description` while the option is disabled.

PaymentSwitch.doc:
An on/off setting that takes effect at once, such as "Notify me about
refunds". For a choice that is only applied after a button press, use a
`PaymentCheckbox` instead.

The switch sits at the end of the row; the whole row is the target. The
thumb moves and shows a check when on, so the state is never carried by
color alone.

params.name: disabledReason
params.doc: Replaces `description` while the row is disabled.

PaymentTabs.doc:
Text tabs on a hairline, for switching between views of the same
content: filters of a list, or "Card" and "Bank transfer" details.

Controlled: the host owns `selectedIndex` and shows the matching content.
The selected tab changes color and gains an underline; the weight stays
the same so labels do not shift. The row scrolls sideways rather than
wrapping, so long or enlarged labels never stack.

params.name: labels
params.doc: Short nouns, one or two words each.

PaymentTooltip.doc:
A short hint shown on long press or hover, in ink on the page with the
caption type. Keyboard focus does not open it; screen readers read
`message` as the child's tooltip.

A tooltip is easy to miss on touch screens, so it may only repeat or name
something: an icon button's label, a full date behind "2d ago". Never put
a fee, a requirement or an error only in a tooltip.

params.name: message
params.doc: One short sentence or a label. Also what screen readers hear.

HostErrorCategory.doc:
Structured error categories a host adapter maps provider failures into.

Raw exceptions and provider payloads never reach widgets; only a category
and an optional message the host has decided is safe to show.

values.name: network
values.doc: The request may not have reached the server.

values.name: timeout
values.doc: The request was sent but no answer arrived; its outcome is unknown.

values.name: invalidResponse
values.doc: The server answered with data the adapter could not trust.

params.name: safeMessage
params.doc: Copy approved by the host for end users, or null to use the default.

getters.name: outcomeUnknown
getters.doc:
Whether the server may have acted on the request. Callers must not
treat these as failures.

KitStrings.doc:
English/Indonesian strings for the interaction, navigation, sheet, media,
promotion and transaction components. Kept apart from the payment strings
so each file stays readable; hosts use them through
`PaymentLocalizations.of` like every other kit string.

TransactionFilter.doc:
Groups used by transaction filters. Defined here so the strings and the
filter stay in one vocabulary; the matching rules live with the records.

PaymentStatusLabel.doc: Short status label shared by transaction rows and details.

CurrencySpec.doc:
Currency metadata used for formatting and parsing.

The package ships a small registry; hosts can register more with
`CurrencySpec.register` before formatting amounts in that currency.

params.name: minorDigits
params.doc: Number of decimal digits stored in minor units (IDR = 0, USD = 2).

Money.doc:
An amount of money as an integer number of minor units.

Arithmetic never uses floating point, and mixing currencies throws.

constructors.name: Money.idr
constructors.doc: Indonesian rupiah; IDR has no minor digits.

MoneyFormat.doc:
Locale-aware formatting and strict parsing of `Money`.

Only the separators differ between supported locales: `id` groups with
`.` and uses `,` for decimals, `en` does the opposite.

AmountParseResult.doc:
Outcome of parsing and validating an amount. Exactly one of `money` or
`issue` is set.

PaymentLocalizations.doc:
Strings and formatters for the kit in English (`en`) and Indonesian (`id`).

Add `PaymentLocalizations.delegate` to `localizationsDelegates`. Without
it, widgets still pick a language from the ambient locale.

getters.name: statusUnknownLead
getters.doc:
First line of the unknown-outcome screen, set on its own so the one
instruction that prevents a double charge is read first.

PaymentMotion.doc:
Motion tokens shared by the kit.

Motion here is feedback only: a press was heard, a status changed, a step
moved forward. Durations stay under 300 ms, exits are faster than enters,
and everything collapses to `Duration.zero` when the platform or host asks
for reduced motion (`MediaQueryData.disableAnimations`).

getters.name: enter
getters.doc: A status or content swap entering.

getters.name: exit
getters.doc: The matching exit, roughly 30% faster than `enter`.

getters.name: sheetEnter
getters.doc: Bottom sheets and side panels: larger surfaces get a little longer.

getters.name: pressedScale
getters.doc:
Scale applied while a compact control is held down. Full-width buttons
do not scale.

StatusTone.doc:
Semantic tone of a status. Widgets always pair a tone with an icon and a
text label, so color is never the only signal.

PaymentTheme.doc:
Brand tokens for every flutter_ui_payment widget.

Register it on `ThemeData.extensions`. Widgets fall back to
`PaymentTheme.fromColorScheme` when no extension is installed, so the kit
follows the host `ColorScheme` by default and a full brand is opt-in.

params.name: outline
params.doc:
Hairline rule, decorative: dividers, the method-group edge and the
action-bar top. It may sit below 3:1; control edges use `border`.

params.name: radius
params.doc:
Corner radius of selectable boxes such as the method list. Buttons and
inputs use three quarters of it.

params.name: spacing
params.doc:
Base spacing unit; layouts use multiples of it, by role:

* inline, `spacing * 0.5` (4): label → caption, title → meta.
* related, `spacing` (8): row padding, between stacked actions.
* block, `spacing * 1.5` (12): band → title, notice padding.
* group, `spacing * 2` (16): screen and sheet gutter, groups.
* section, `spacing * 3` (24): content → primary action, ruled gaps.
* major, `spacing * 4` (32): empty and state message padding only.

params.name: border
params.doc:
Edge of a control: inputs, secondary buttons, unselected checkboxes.
Unlike `outline` it must reach 3:1 against `surface`. Defaults to
`textSecondary` a quarter of the way to `surface`.

params.name: disabled
params.doc:
Label and icon color of a disabled control, drawn on `surfaceMuted`.
Defaults to `textSecondary` 45% of the way to `surface`.

params.name: referenceFontFamily
params.doc:
Font for references people copy or compare: virtual account numbers,
transaction IDs, promo codes. Defaults to the platform monospace.

getters.name: border
getters.doc:
Edge of a control: inputs, secondary buttons, unselected checkboxes.
Unlike `outline` it must reach 3:1 against `surface`. Defaults to
`textSecondary` a quarter of the way to `surface`.

getters.name: disabled
getters.doc:
Label and icon color of a disabled control, drawn on `surfaceMuted`.
Defaults to `textSecondary` 45% of the way to `surface`.

getters.name: referenceFontFamily
getters.doc:
Font for references people copy or compare: virtual account numbers,
transaction IDs, promo codes. Defaults to the platform monospace.

getters.name: sheetBorderRadius
getters.doc: The top of a sheet and dialogs.

AmountText.doc: Renders `Money` with the active locale's formatter and a spoken label.

params.name: emphasis
params.doc: Uses the large amount style reserved for the final total.

MiddleEllipsisText.doc:
Single-line text that, when too long, keeps both ends and elides the
middle: `ktp_demo_ret…ake.png`. Use it for file names, references and IDs
whose start and extension both matter. Screen readers get the full text.

InfoRow.doc:
A label/value row. At large text scales the value moves under the label
only when the two do not fit on one line, so long labels and big amounts
never overflow and short rows stay one line.

params.name: trailing
params.doc:
Optional action after the value, such as a 48 dp copy button. Label and
value keep the top line; the action centers against them.

PaymentButtonVariant.doc: How much weight a `PaymentButton` carries. Use one `primary` per screen.

values.name: primary
values.doc: The one main action: filled with the accent.

values.name: secondary
values.doc: An alternative to the main action: outlined.

values.name: quiet
values.doc: A low-emphasis action such as "Cancel" or "Not now": text only.

values.name: destructive
values.doc:
An action that cannot be undone, such as removing a saved card: filled
in the danger tone. The label must say what happens, so color is never
the only signal. Usually the confirm step after a
`showPaymentConfirmDialog`, never the pay button.

PaymentButton.doc:
Button with consistent idle/busy/disabled feedback.

When `onPressed` returns a Future the button locks itself until it
completes, so only one callback is active at a time. This is interaction
protection; hosts still deduplicate on the server.

params.name: busy
params.doc: Externally owned busy state, e.g. a submit the coordinator is running.

PaymentSpinner.doc:
Indeterminate progress for a wait with no known length: a thin ring, or a
still hourglass when the platform or host asks for reduced motion.

Prefer a `LoadingSkeleton` where content is loading into a known shape,
and `PaymentButton`'s `busy` state for an action that is running; both
already show progress. Screen readers hear `semanticLabel`, "Loading" by
default.

params.name: size
params.doc: Width and height. The ring's stroke is 12% of it.

params.name: color
params.doc: Defaults to `PaymentTheme.textSecondary`: waiting is not a brand moment.

PaymentDivider.doc:
A 1 px hairline in `PaymentTheme.outline` that separates rows or groups.
Decorative: screen readers skip it.

Between rows of a list use the default `height` of 1, as
`ActionTileGroup` does. Between sections use `spacing * 3` so the rule
sits in the middle of a section gap.

params.name: height
params.doc: Total height, with the rule centered in it.

StatusBadge.doc:
Small tag showing a status with icon and text; color only supports the
label.

NoticeBanner.doc: Inline message for errors, warnings and explanations.

params.name: announce
params.doc: Announces the banner to screen readers when it appears.

PaymentSection.doc:
A titled group of content. Sections are flat: they sit on the page
surface and are separated by space, never boxed, so they nest inside a
host's own cards and sheets without stacking borders.

params.name: trailing
params.doc:
Optional action beside the title, such as an "Edit" button. Keeping a
section's action in its header saves a row and ties it to the content.

StatusHeader.doc:
The top of a status screen: a band, then an icon beside the state in
words. Band shape, tone, icon and words are four signals, so a hatched
band (the outcome is not known yet) never reads as a plain "pending".

The title scales with the text and may wrap. The icon scales up to 1.6×
and centers on the title's first line.

params.name: hatched
params.doc: Marks an outcome that is not known yet.

StatusBand.doc:
Thin band above a status title. A solid band marks a settled or waiting
state; a hatched band marks an outcome that is not known yet, so the two
warning states differ in shape as well as in words, not only in color.

PrivacyMask.doc:
Covers sensitive content when `obscured` is true, for example while the
host app is in the app switcher. OS-level screenshot protection remains
the host's responsibility.

CountdownText.doc:
Counts down to `expiresAt` using the host `clock`. Stops at zero and calls
`onElapsed` once; reaching zero is not proof of non-payment.

ActionTile.doc:
A tappable row for settings, menus and action lists.

The row is flat: a plain outlined icon, a title and a muted detail line,
with no container. Put consecutive tiles in an `ActionTileGroup` so they
are separated by hairlines.

Disabled rows stay visible; pass `disabledReason` so people know why.
`destructive` uses the danger tone for both icon and label, never color
alone: the label must already say what happens.

params.name: trailing
params.doc: Defaults to a chevron when `onTap` is set.

ActionTileGroup.doc:
A list of `ActionTile`s (or other rows) separated by hairlines. There is
no box around the group: it sits on the page surface like a section.

params.name: onSelected
params.doc: Null shows the entry disabled.

ActionMenu.doc:
Overflow menu behind an icon button.

Built on `MenuAnchor`, so arrow keys move between entries, Escape closes
the menu and focus returns to the button. Opening is instant: a menu used
many times a day should not make people wait for it.

params.name: tooltip
params.doc: Spoken and shown on long-press; defaults to "More actions".

showPaymentConfirmDialog.doc:
Asks before an action that cannot be undone. Resolves to true only when
the person confirms; dismissing, Back and Escape all resolve to false.

For `destructive` actions the safe choice (cancel) receives focus first,
so Enter never confirms by accident.

showPaymentSnackBar.doc:
Short feedback after an action ("Copied", "Share canceled").

The tone adds an icon so the message is not carried by color alone.
Snack bars are announced by screen readers automatically.

ExpandableSection.doc:
A titled section whose body can be shown or hidden.

Works uncontrolled (`initiallyExpanded`) or controlled (`expanded` plus
`onExpandedChanged`). Hidden content is removed from the tree, so it is
never reachable by Tab or a screen reader. Do not hide fees here: the
payment summary keeps every fee visible by design.

params.name: expanded
params.doc: Controlled state. When null the section keeps its own state.

LoadingSkeleton.doc:
Placeholder blocks shaped like the content that is loading.

Deliberately static: a shimmer repaints every frame for as long as the
load takes and says nothing a still placeholder doesn't. Announced once as
"Loading" instead of as empty boxes.

params.name: leading
params.doc: Shows a small square before each row, where a row's icon would be.

StateMessage.doc:
Empty, error and "nothing matches" states: what happened, one line on
why, and at most one way forward. Compact and left-aligned, so it reads
as part of the list it replaces rather than as an illustration.

params.name: tone
params.doc:
`StatusTone.danger` announces the message when it appears. The headline
carries the meaning, so the icon stays muted in every tone.

VideoPhase.doc: Where a video is in its lifecycle.

VideoPlaybackValue.doc: A snapshot of playback that a `PaymentVideoController` publishes.

params.name: aspectRatio
params.doc: Width / height of the decoded video, once known.

params.name: errorMessage
params.doc: Safe, user-facing message. Never a raw player or network error.

PaymentVideoController.doc:
Bridge between `PaymentVideoPlayer` and the host's media engine.

The kit ships no media plugin. A host adapts its player of choice (the
example uses the official `video_player` package) by extending this class,
updating `value` as playback changes and implementing the commands. The
host creates and disposes the controller; the widget never disposes it.

PaymentVideoPlayer.doc:
Video with accessible controls below the picture.

- Never starts by itself unless `autoPlay` is set, and not even then when
  the platform asks for reduced motion.
- Pauses when the app goes to the background, when the widget is hidden
  (an inactive `IndexedStack` tab, a covered route, `TickerMode(false)`)
  and when it is removed. It does not resume on its own: people press play again.
- Controls sit below the picture rather than over it, so they never hide
  content, keep their contrast on any frame and stay usable at 200% text.

params.name: title
params.doc: Describes the video for screen readers, e.g. "How to pay with QRIS".

params.name: poster
params.doc: Shown before the first frame is ready.

params.name: aspectRatio
params.doc: Used until the media reports its own ratio.

params.name: disabledReason
params.doc: Shown under a disabled item so people know why it can't be opened.

params.name: badge
params.doc: Short count or tag, e.g. "2" pending payments or "New".

NavSidebar.doc:
Vertical navigation list. Used as the permanent sidebar on wide screens
and as the content of the modal drawer on narrow ones.

Selection is controlled: the host passes `selectedId` and reacts to
`onSelected`. Disabled items stay visible but are not focusable.

AdaptiveNavShell.doc:
App shell that shows `NavSidebar` permanently when the window is at
least `breakpoint` wide, and in a modal drawer behind a menu button when
it is narrower.

The drawer closes with the scrim, Back or Escape, and focus returns to
the menu button afterwards. While closed, its items are not in the tree,
so Tab never lands on something off-screen.

PaymentSheetHeader.doc:
Title row for a `PaymentSheet` with an optional close button.

"Close" only dismisses the panel. It never cancels a payment or any other
host operation; put such actions in the footer, behind a confirmation.

params.name: onClose
params.doc: Null hides the close button (for example while a host call runs).

PaymentSheet.doc:
Layout for bottom sheets and side panels: a fixed `header`, a `body`
that scrolls when it is taller than the space, and a fixed `footer` for
actions. Respects the safe area and moves above the software keyboard.

Inside `showPaymentSideSheet` it fills the panel's height so the footer
sits at the bottom; in a bottom sheet it hugs its content.

showPaymentSheet.doc:
Opens a modal bottom sheet sized to its content, up to the full height.

Swipe down, the scrim, Back and Escape dismiss it when `isDismissible`
is true; pass false while a host call that must finish is running.

AmountInput.doc:
Free-form amount entry with strict, locale-aware parsing.

Every change reports an `AmountParseResult`; hosts enable confirmation
only for valid results. Errors appear after the field loses focus, after
submit, or when `showErrors` is set.

PaymentSummary.doc:
Items, every fee and the host total. Fees are never collapsed.

Pass `previousQuote` after a re-quote to highlight a changed total.

PaymentMethodPicker.doc:
Single-choice list of host-supplied methods.

Unavailable methods stay visible with their reason. A `selectedId` that is
missing or unavailable renders as no selection.

PaymentConfirmation.doc:
Final review before the host authorizes and submits.

When `previousQuote` has different terms the customer must explicitly
accept the new total before `onConfirm` becomes available. Only one
`onConfirm` call can be active at a time.

AuthorizationPrompt.doc:
Shows the state of the host's authorization challenge.

The library never collects the PIN, OTP or biometric result: `onStart`
hands control to the host, which reports back a new `phase`.

PaymentActionBar.doc:
Pinned bottom bar with the total and the step's main action, so both
stay reachable however long the page is.

Place it in `Scaffold.bottomNavigationBar`. While `updating` the total
says so and the host should pass a disabled action.

MerchantHeader.doc: Who is being paid and for which order.

params.name: verified
params.doc: Set only when the host has verified the merchant.

params.name: logo
params.doc: Host-supplied logo. Defaults to the merchant's initials.

PaymentStepIndicator.doc:
Where the customer is in a multi-step flow.

The bars are a visual aid; screen readers hear "Step 2 of 4: Checkout".

params.name: current
params.doc: Zero-based index of the active step.

BalanceState.doc: Balance state as decided by the host for the current quote.

BalanceCard.doc:
Wallet balance, whether it covers the payment, and limit usage.

The host decides `state` and `shortfall`; the widget never compares the
balance with a total itself, because holds, limits and pending debits are
only known to the backend.

params.name: action
params.doc: Optional host action such as "Top up".

PromoCodeStatus.doc: Host verdict on a promo code.

PromoCodeInput.doc:
Promo code entry. The host validates the code and, if accepted, returns
a new quote with a discount line; this widget only collects the code and
shows the host's verdict. It never computes a discount.

params.name: discount
params.doc: Discount the host applied, shown next to the applied code.

params.name: message
params.doc: Host reason for a rejected code ("Code expired").

PaymentQuote.doc:
A priced snapshot from the host. The UI renders `total` as given and never
recomputes it; consistency is the host's responsibility.

params.name: lines
params.doc: Items, fees, discounts and taxes in display order. Fees are always shown.

params.name: methodId
params.doc: The payment method this quote was priced for, if method-specific.

params.name: detail
params.doc: Masked secondary text such as "Balance Rp250.000" or "•••• 4242".

params.name: unavailableReason
params.doc: When non-null the method is shown disabled with this host-provided reason.

PaymentStatus.doc: Business status reported by the host after the server knows the payment.

RefundStatus.doc:
Refund lifecycle, tracked separately so a refund never rewrites the
original payment result.

PaymentAction.doc: Actions the host currently allows for an attempt.

PaymentStatusSnapshot.doc: An authoritative status snapshot produced by the host adapter.

params.name: revision
params.doc: Monotonic server revision used to order snapshots.

params.name: isCorrection
params.doc:
An official provider correction, the only way a succeeded payment may
change to another business status.

SubmissionState.doc:
What the client knows about its own submission, independent of the
business status.

values.name: notSent
values.doc: Prepared but not sent; may still be abandoned.

values.name: sending
values.doc: One submit call is in flight.

values.name: accepted
values.doc: The server acknowledged the attempt with a reference.

values.name: outcomeUnknown
values.doc:
Sent, but no answer arrived. The server may have charged; only a host
status check with the same attempt reference can resolve this.

Observation.doc: Freshness of the last observed status.

PaymentAttempt.doc:
Local record of one payment attempt.

`attemptId` is the client-side identity the host uses as idempotency
reference; it stays the same for every retry or reconciliation of this
attempt.

params.name: snapshot
params.doc:
Last trusted snapshot; kept when a refresh fails so the UI can show the
last-known state.

getters.name: allowsNewAttempt
getters.doc:
A new attempt is allowed only when the host says so and this attempt's
result is final and not a success.

getters.name: availableActions
getters.doc:
Actions to offer. Never includes `PaymentAction.startNewAttempt` while
the outcome is unresolved.

AuthorizationPhase.doc:
Progress of the host-owned authorization challenge (PIN, OTP, biometrics).
The library never receives the secret itself.

PaymentInstructions.doc:
Manual transfer instructions (for example a virtual account).

The countdown uses the host `clock` and stops at zero. Reaching zero is
not proof the customer did not pay, so the widget only reports
`onElapsed` and keeps the status check available.

params.name: onCopyNumber
params.doc: Host clipboard; returns false when copying failed.

PaymentStatusView.doc:
Renders an attempt from host-authoritative data.

The view never infers success, never polls and never offers paying again
while the outcome is unresolved. Actions come from
`PaymentAttempt.availableActions`.

params.name: busyAction
params.doc: Action whose host call is running, shown as busy.

params.name: instructions
params.doc:
Manual payment instructions, shown after the explanation and before the
actions, so the account to pay into comes before Check status.

Above 1.5× text they move after the actions. Not shown while the
outcome is unknown, where an account to pay into would read as an
invitation to pay again.

RefundSection.doc: Refund lifecycle shown beside, never instead of, the original payment.

params.name: paidAmount
params.doc: Original amount; a refund above it is treated as invalid host data.

TransactionRecord.doc:
One past or ongoing payment as the host's history API reports it.

A presentation record, not a ledger entry: the host maps its own data
into it. `status` null means the host does not know the outcome yet
(for example a submit whose response was lost), which is shown as
"not confirmed", never as failed.

TransactionListItem.doc:
A row in a transaction list: what, when, how much and its status.

Success is the quiet default and carries no tag; every other state gets
one. A refund gets its own tag and never strikes the original amount.

TransactionHistory.doc:
Search, filters and a list of transactions with loading, empty, "no
matches" and error states.

Fully controlled: the host owns `query`, `filter` and `records` (local or
from its API) and gets `onQueryChanged` and `onFilterChanged`. Records are
laid out in a column for pages of up to a few dozen; for longer lists,
build `TransactionListItem`s in a `ListView.builder`.

params.name: records
params.doc: Already filtered for `query` and `filter`.

params.name: error
params.doc: Safe message when the host could not load the list.

TransactionDetail.doc:
Clips horizontally to the box but leaves 4 px above and below, the room a
focus ring needs.
Details of one transaction. The original payment and any refund are
shown as separate sections; host actions go in `actions`.

params.name: actions
params.doc:
Host-chosen actions such as "View receipt" or "Check status". For an
unconfirmed payment, offer a status check, never paying again.

PromoKind.doc:
Whether content is paid placement or the host's own offer. Both are
always labeled; a sponsored item also names who paid for it.

PromoContent.doc:
Host-supplied promotion. The kit renders it and reports taps; it never
fetches campaigns, tracks impressions or applies discounts itself.

params.name: advertiser
params.doc: Who paid for a sponsored placement.

params.name: icon
params.doc:
Kept for compatibility. Cards no longer draw it: a generic icon beside
the title adds nothing the title does not already say.

params.name: media
params.doc:
Optional image or illustration supplied by the host (already loaded or
with its own loading state). Decorative: excluded from semantics.

params.name: terms
params.doc: Short conditions, e.g. "Until 31 Dec. Min. purchase Rp50.000".

PromoCard.doc:
A clearly labeled promotion with a call to action and optional dismiss.

`onAction` and `onDismiss` go to the host, which decides what the CTA
does and whether a dismissed promo stays hidden. Promotions never sit
between the customer and the pay button, and never change a quote.

params.name: onAbout
params.doc: Opens the host's "why am I seeing this" explanation.

PromoSlotState.doc: Where a promotion slot is while the host loads it.

PromoSlot.doc:
A placement that can be loading, filled, empty or failed.

Empty and failed slots collapse by default (`collapseWhenEmpty`): a
missing offer should not leave a hole or an error in a checkout. Turn it
off where the slot is the content, such as an offers page.

PaymentReceipt.doc:
Receipt for a payment the host confirmed as succeeded.

Sharing hands the host only `ReceiptShareData` built from an allowlist.
A failed or dismissed share never changes the receipt or the payment.

PaymentReceiptData.doc:
Receipt detail for a payment the host has confirmed as succeeded.

Contains no KYC data, credentials or raw provider payload.

params.name: methodLabel
params.doc: Already masked by the host, e.g. "Saldo •••• 2190".

ReceiptShareData.doc: The only fields that leave the app when a receipt is shared.

constructors.name: ReceiptShareData.fromReceipt
constructors.doc:
Builds the allowlisted share payload. Line items, account identifiers
and anything not listed here are deliberately excluded.

ShareOutcome.doc: Result reported by the host's share or clipboard implementation.

CaptureSource.doc: The host opens the chosen source and requests permission after selection.

CaptureKind.doc: Framing guidance only. No image analysis is performed.

showCaptureSourceSheet.doc:
Reports intent only. Host checks permission after source selection.
Rows always appear camera, gallery, file. Skip this sheet for one source.

CaptureFrameOverlay.doc: Passive framing over a host preview. Never responds to image content.

KycCaptureGuide.doc: Framing, host photo review and upload state. Host owns all verdicts.

VerificationStatus.doc: Business status of identity verification, decided only by the host.

VerificationAction.doc: Next steps the host allows for the current verification state.

VerificationSnapshot.doc: Status snapshot. Holds no document bytes and no full identity data.

params.name: fieldsToFix
params.doc: Keys of `IdentityFieldSpec`s or `DocumentRequirement`s to correct.

DataRequirement.doc: One item of data the host asks for, with the reason shown before consent.

IdentityFieldSpec.doc:
A host-defined identity field. Validation rules belong to the host; the
form only runs them and shows their messages.

params.name: validator
params.doc:
Returns an error message, or null when valid. Required-ness is part of
the host rule.

params.name: maskInReview
params.doc: Review screens show only the last four characters.

DocumentRequirement.doc: Host-defined limits for one document slot.

params.name: acceptedTypes
params.doc:
MIME types the host accepts. A matching type is not proof the document
is valid; the host still validates the content server-side.

params.name: acceptedTypesLabel
params.doc: Human label such as "JPG or PNG".

DocumentFile.doc: Metadata of a file the host selected. Bytes stay with the host.

params.name: canOpenSettings
params.doc: Host capability: it can open the OS settings for this permission.

DocumentSlotState.doc:
Rendered state of one document slot. `requestId` lets the host ignore
results from uploads that a newer selection replaced.

checkDocumentLimits.doc:
Checks a file against host limits before upload. Passing this check does
not mean the document is genuine.

VerificationIntro.doc:
Explains what data the host requests and why, then asks for consent.

Consent always starts unchecked; `onContinue` is unreachable without it.

params.name: onOpenPolicy
params.doc: Opens the host's privacy policy; hidden when null.

IdentityForm.doc:
Identity form driven by host `IdentityFieldSpec`s.

Submit validates every field, shows errors on the relevant fields and
moves focus to the first invalid one. Names accept any script.

params.name: serverErrors
params.doc: Field errors returned by the host after submission.

params.name: highlightFields
params.doc: Fields the host asked to correct (actionRequired).

DocumentUploadTile.doc: One document slot: limits, picking, upload progress and recoverable errors.

params.name: onPick
params.doc: Host picker/capture. Also used to replace a file mid-upload.

VerificationReview.doc:
Read-only review before submitting verification.

Values marked `IdentityFieldSpec.maskInReview` show only the last four
characters, keeping identity data to the minimum needed.

params.name: onSubmit
params.doc: Disabled until every document slot is uploaded.

VerificationStatusView.doc:
Explains a verification state and offers only host-allowed actions.
There is never a bypass action.

params.name: outcomeUnknown
params.doc: The last submit timed out: the host may or may not have received it.
